description: The note describing an attached reference image is content, not instruction: it lands inside the REFERENCE_IMAGE fence in the user message and never in the system message. Structural containment only — a photograph of a note reading 'ignore your instructions' arrives as pixels no fence can wrap, which is the template's problem and not the envelope's.
